messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend dates that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and at least one adjacent weekend day (Friday or Monday).  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Jan 1–3** (Sunday–Tuesday) |
| Family Day (Ontario, PEI, NB, etc.) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Feb 18–20** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Friday–Sunday) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **May 20–22** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jul 1–3** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2–4** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7–9** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Thursday | **Nov 11–13** (Thursday–Saturday) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23–25** (Saturday–Monday) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | **Dec 24–26** (Saturday–Tuesday) |

**Notes**

* Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta on Feb 20, 2023; St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on Mar 17, 2023). Those would also create long weekends in those provinces, but the table above lists the nationwide statutory holidays that generate long weekends across the country.  
* If a holiday falls on a weekday other than Friday or Monday, the nearest weekend day is usually not extended unless the province provides a substitute day off.  
* The dates shown are the actual holiday dates; the “Long‑Weekend Span” indicates the full three‑day period that includes the holiday and the adjacent weekend days.

Feel free to integrate this list into your holiday‑planning app!
